items.name: Bushrangers Bay Walk, Mornington Peninsula National Park
items.note: 5.4 km return (about 2 hrs) through coastal scrub to a wild basalt bay; spring brings out the coastal windflowers. No swimming here.

items.name: Camels Hump, Macedon Regional Park
items.note: The park's 1,011 m high point, with views across to Hanging Rock; pair it with the Memorial Cross walk and spring gardens on the mountain.

items.name: Beeripmo Walk, Mount Buangor National Park
items.note: 21 km Grade 3 overnighter with a campground halfway, in a park newly proclaimed a national park on 5 Oct; some former state-park areas are still closed after the 2024 fire.

items.name: 10,000 Steps Loop Trail, Woowookarung Regional Park
items.note: New 8 km multi-use loop opened for the park's 10th birthday, with a lookout; spring wildflowers line the route.

items.name: Bellarine Rail Trail
items.note: 35 km mostly flat ride from South Geelong (train-friendly) through farmland to Queenscliff; finish with fish and chips by the water.

items.name: O'Keefe Rail Trail
items.note: 49 km rail trail from Bendigo station; Axedale makes a 23 km turnaround, or ride on to Heathcote's wineries.

items.name: Ann Wilson & Tripsitter: The Voice of Heart, with Dragon
items.note: Heart's Rock and Roll Hall of Fame frontwoman singing Heart classics, with Dragon in support.

items.name: The Church: A Psychedelic Symphony with The George Ellis Orchestra
items.note: Under the Milky Way, Reptile and Almost With You reworked with a 30-piece orchestra.

items.name: Boyz II Men, with Salt-N-Pepa and Bell Biv DeVoe (A Day On The Green)
items.note: Three 90s R&B/hip-hop legends at one winery show, an easy day trip down the Princes Fwy.

items.name: Harry Styles: Together, Together
items.note: Stadium residency run with three Melbourne nights; the later dates are the ones to look at.

items.name: The Rubens
items.note: This weekend: the Aussie rock band in the city's best-looking room.

items.name: Del Amitri: Past to Present
items.note: The Scottish band's four-decade greatest-hits tour; tickets on general sale now.

items.name: Beth Orton
items.note: New on sale: general sale opens today (Thu 5 Nov) at 12pm, behind new album The Ground Above.

items.name: Disturbed: The Sickness and the Greatest Hits
items.note: Just announced; on sale since 30 Oct via AXS.

items.name: MUNA
items.note: New on sale: general sale opens Fri 6 Nov at 1pm.

items.name: Dara Ó Briain: Re:Creation
items.note: The Mock the Week host's first Australian tour since 2019, mostly improvised crowd-work; one Melbourne night.

items.name: Tom Allen: Totally
items.note: New on sale: general sale opens today (Thu 5 Nov) at 11am via Marriner Group; one night only, six months before the UK gets it.

items.name: Vittorio Angelone: You Can't Say Nothing Any More
items.note: Selling fast: the first two nights sold out, so a third (28 Nov) was added.

items.name: Josh Wolf: Touring Hard
items.note: US stand-up on his 2027 Australian tour; doors 6:30pm.

items.name: Guy Montgomery: What Do People Do All Day?
items.note: New on sale: general sale opens today (Thu 5 Nov) at 12pm for the Kiwi comic's new show.

items.name: Melbourne City v Western Sydney Wanderers (A-League Men)
items.note: Round 4 Saturday-night football; gates open 6:30pm.

items.name: Boxing Day Test, Australia v New Zealand (Day 1)
items.note: Book Day 1 now through Ticketek before the reserved seats go.

items.name: Melbourne United v Brisbane Bullets
items.note: This weekend: the club page has a 20% off AXS ticket link for this game.

items.name: SE Melbourne Phoenix v Illawarra Hawks (Ignite Cup)
items.note: Phoenix's first Ignite Cup game, close to home in Wantirna South; tickets via AXS.

items.name: Throwdown 35: Melbourne United v SE Melbourne Phoenix
items.note: The Melbourne derby, the loudest night of the NBL season.

items.name: Melbourne United v New Zealand Breakers (Indigenous Round)
items.note: Indigenous Round game; next United home games are 6 Dec (Bullets) and 12 Dec (JackJumpers).

items.name: SE Melbourne Phoenix v Cairns Taipans
items.note: A Sunday-afternoon game that works for kids; Phoenix are next at JCA v Sydney Kings on 19 Dec.

items.name: All About Eve
items.note: Australian premiere of Ivo van Hove's stage version of the 1950 film, directed by Dean Bryant.

items.name: A Room with a View
items.note: MTC's new stage adaptation of E.M. Forster's romance.

items.name: American Psycho: A Musical Thriller
items.note: Time Out's 5-star review: a slick, darkly funny return season of the Duncan Sheik musical.

items.name: The Great Gatsby (musical)
items.note: The jazz-age musical lands at Her Majesty's in January; the show site has a waitlist for tickets.

items.name: Banksy Limitless
items.note: 250+ works, new sculptures and a hologram room; book ahead as sessions sell out.

items.name: Plant Life: The Nature of Design
items.note: Free show on design's plant-based future: fungus leather, hemp fibreboard, algae bricks.

items.name: WARNE: Treasures of a Legend
items.note: The Gatting Ball, the 700th-wicket ball and the floppy hat; extended for the summer of cricket.

items.name: Our Wondrous Planet
items.note: Immersive reef, rainforest and ice rooms with 800+ animals; included with museum entry.

items.name: Art in the Vines: Art in Motion 2
items.note: 20+ kinetic sculptures in the vines; pair it with the Camels Hump walk.

items.name: Makers and Shakers Christmas Market
items.note: 120+ Australian makers for early Christmas shopping, plus food trucks and a free kids' play space.

items.name: Borneo Night Market
items.note: This weekend: a free two-day Bornean night market by the river.

items.name: Burrata Festival
items.when: Fri 13 Nov (ticketed opening night) and Sat 14-Sun 15 Nov, 10am-3pm
items.note: Free weekend of tastings, mozzarella-making demos and a Burrata Trail.

items.name: Garage Sale Trail
items.note: Almost 500 Melbourne garage sales over two weekends; plan a route with the map.

items.name: Melbourne's Christmas Wonderland
items.note: Big indoor Christmas attraction close to home in Caulfield; book a session ahead.
